gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-hoover: Delius Unicase writes in relaxed, rope-ladder spacing, its strokes ending blunt with no brush-style swelling, while Hoover brings a sturdier, refined voice. Hoover is better with brief copy, so nudge its size up.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-technor: Technor glows like neon tubing, one line thickness throughout. Delius Unicase does best with relaxed, untapered handwriting, while Technor does best at cool geometric clarity, comfortable in modest helpings.
gen-gf-dynapuff-fs-karma: Karma reads trustworthy and classic, its terminals finishing clear of the stem and its caps barely taller than lowercase, under bold DynaPuff. Pinch-free DynaPuff against slightly pinched Karma is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-dynapuff-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, its caps barely above lowercase. Round, bent-wire letters from DynaPuff give the pairing its strongest pull, with Paquito built for brisk, brief bouts of reading.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-fs-bespoke-sans: Eagle Lake looks hand-drawn and loose, with gaps between glyphs and a mild weight shift from stem to serif. Bespoke Sans sits beside it sharp and refined, a foil to that looseness, though not made for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-fs-chillax: Eagle Lake writes loose and personal, arches thinning off the stem. Chillax, cut from one gauge of tubing with unfinished loops, keeps reading casual, though it is happiest in brief spells.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-fs-gambetta: Gambetta is bookish and graceful, with wide channels into each counter. Loose Eagle Lake handwriting over that classic serif is the real draw, and Gambetta is happier with brief text.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-fs-plein: Hand-drawn and easygoing, Eagle Lake keeps its thin parts only slightly slimmer than its stems. Plein steps in with a clear channel into each round letter, reliable for brief text.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-fs-roundo: Roundo reads with a skimming ease, its n arch matching its stem and every small counter left unclogged. Eagle Lake does warm handwriting best; Roundo does quick skimming, not long paragraphs.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-fs-spline-sans: Eagle Lake is loose and personal, dipping modestly in thin strokes. Warm handwriting is its best trick, while Spline Sans does contemporary, rope-like consistency best, meant for quick sittings.
